data.name: Kavyansh
data.gender_notes: Kavyansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kavya means 'poetry' or 'wisdom' and Ansh means 'essence' or 'manifestation'. This name signifies a wise, intelligent and knowledgeable individual who embodies the essence of poetry and wisdom. The name Kavyansh carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent, Scholar” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Kavyansh usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent, scholar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kavyansh is a divine name that represents the manifestation of divine wisdom and knowledge. It is believed to bring blessings of intelligence, creativity, and poetic abilities.
data.etymology: Kavyansh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Intelligent, Scholar.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kavyansh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
